name: Chevron Power Lateral
researcher_notes: The Texas Railroad Commission construction report dated September 18, 2026 lists a new natural gas transmission system named Chevron Power Lateral. The report entry is 26-NC-096, filed April 17, 2026 by WWM Operating, LLC. It covers Pecos and Reeves counties, 22.23 miles of 36-inch pipe, with a planned construction start of July 1, 2026. No existing row matches. Status is construction on the strength of that planned start date; no source confirms the work has begun. The data center tag is left blank. The Chevron and Microsoft plant near Pecos (Project Kilby, built by Energy Forge One) is real. A June 2026 news report says Microsoft will buy its power under a 20-year deal. The state air permit notice puts Energy Forge One's gas plant near Pecos in Reeves County. But no source found says this lateral serves that plant. The link rests only on the line name and location, so it is not enough for the tag. If a source ties the lateral to the plant, add DataCenter yes, with the plant and Microsoft deal as the second reference. The line is longer than 25 km, so it qualifies as a new row without the tag. Start and end places are not given. The owner name WWM Operating has no close match in the ownership list; the team spelling drops the comma. Intrastate line, so no FERC filing is expected. Route not researched beyond the report.
